layers.source_crs: EPSG:3857 from included .prj; archive WGS84 filename is not geographic-degree coordinates
layers.transformation: Inverse spherical Web Mercator (R=6378137m) to WGS84 longitude/latitude. Whole features whose nearest boundary is within approximately 300m of pin are retained. Feature geometry is not cut at circle boundary.
layers.source_z_values: All clipped source vertex Z values are 0.0 and must not be treated as measured roof or ground elevations.
layers.height_vintage: Included README identifies LiDAR-derived heights as 2015 LiDAR. Site Plan dates and construction status are unspecified.2025 is release/export year, not a common survey date.
layers.vertical_datum: Not specified in included metadata; HEIGHT_MSL described as mean-sea-level metres. Do not assume equivalence with CGVD2013, CGVD28 or WGS84 ellipsoid heights.
layers.use: Can extrude AVG_HEIGHT above a flat display baseline for clearly labelled reference massing. Source imagery, permits and video observations remain separate evidence.

layers.count_unit: polygons including garages/miscellaneous structures, not distinct buildings
layers.source_crs: EPSG:2952; service EPSG:3857; output requested EPSG:4326
layers.query: Point -79.443862,43.7234276 with 300 m distance, ArcGIS spatial intersects, whole features returned
layers.actual_acquisition_date: Unspecified; maintenance dates are edits, not observation dates
layers.ELEVATION_definition: Ground elevation of the feature (official CKAN field dictionary)
layers.DERIVED_HEIGHT_definition: Height of the feature derived from LiDAR data (official CKAN field dictionary)
layers.limitations: Data is collected via manual digitization from aerial imagery. It has a ground accuracy of +/- 30cm. Added/deleted/moved features may not be reflected in the dataset immediately due to operational constraints. Due to the inability to see features located close to tall buildings, or in areas of deep shadow; some features may not be collected. Based on the sheer scale and physical area of the City of Toronto not all features are collected annually. This data is not to be used as a substitute for a legal survey. The data is to be used for analysis and visualization purposes.

layers.selection: CKAN rows for a bounded list of nearby street names, then whole segments within approximately 300m of pin. This is not an exhaustive road network.
